SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT INPUT_DATE, INPUT_ID, PMOK_CODE FROM RTMRO01 WHERE IF_STATUS = '1'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KUKD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, INPUT_DATE AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(A.PMOK_CODE,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, INPUT_DATE AS ADD_DATE, NVL(A.INPUT_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, NVL(A.PMOK_CODE,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.PMOK_NAME,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(TRIM(A.PMOK_SIZE1||' '||A.PMOK_SIZE2),' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(A.PMOK_UNIT_NAME,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(A.BASE_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, 1 AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(A.MAKER,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ' ' AS ORIGIN_NAME, ' ' AS RD_DATE, ' ' AS EP_DATE, NVL(A.MANAGE_TEXT,' ') AS REMARK FROM RTMRO01 A WHERE A.IF_STATUS = '1' AND INPUT_DATE = '$G_RS.INPUT_DATE$' AND INPUT_ID = '$G_RS.INPUT_ID$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.PMOK_CODE$' ORDER BY A.INPUT_DATE, A.INPUT_ID, A.PMOK_CODE
UPDATE KEP_GE SET IF_STATUS = '2' WHERE IF_STATUS = '1' AND INPUT_DATE = '$G_RS.INPUT_DATE$' AND INPUT_ID = '$G_RS.INPUT_ID$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.PMOK_CODE$'
